content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00235 The RTE shall dequeue a trigger when the RTE is informed about the end of exe- cution of all triggered ExecutableEntitys which are triggered by this trigger emitter . In the case of triggered ExecutableEntitys s whose execution is dis- abled by a mode disabling dependency then the trigger is dequeued as if the entities ran. This behaviour prevents the dequeue operation from being blocked indefinitely.
